name: Blog Diagrams
prompt_template:
In this project you will help me make great diagrams that follow our brand guidelines. I have existing diagrams (I'll upload them one by one in png) and you need to make them follow brand colors and style + apply small tweaks as requested by me. The output should be good, consistent svgs.

lso let’s use brand colors and corner radius: Brand colors (hex) Token │ Hex ------------------------------ Base / backgrounds
   •  tinfoil-bg — #FFFFFF (page background)
   •  tinfoil-light — #F9F8F6 (default light section)
     •  .cool — #F0F4F4
   •  tinfoil-box-beige — #EEECE8 (boxes/cards)

   Dark (text & dark sections) — tinfoil-dark
   •  DEFAULT — #061820
   •  subtle rgba(6,24,32,.10) · soft .30 · medium .60 · bold .90

   Accent Dark (primary teal) — tinfoil-accent-dark
   •  DEFAULT — #004444
   •  hover — #005555 · darker — #003333
   •  subtle .10 · soft .30 · medium .60 · bold .90 (of 0,68,68)

   Accent Light (mint/emerald) — tinfoil-accent-light
   •  DEFAULT — #68C7AC
   •  darker — #5AB39A
   •  subtle .10 · soft .30 · medium .60 · bold .90 (of 104,199,172)

   Other
   •  tinfoil-muted — #4B7B7A

You will need to use fonts: 
### Typography

**Fonts:** Aeonik (H1/H2 only), Aeonik Fono (everything else: H3, body, label, button).

**Single source of truth:** the scale lives in `tailwind.config.js > theme.extend.fontSize`
(`text-h1`, `text-h2`, `text-h3`, `text-body-l`, `text-body`, `text-label`, `text-button` — each
token bakes in size, line-height, tracking and weight). Consume it only through the components in
`src/components/text.tsx`: `H1`, `H2`, `H3`, `Body`, `Lead` (Body-l), `Label`, `Subheading`, and the
`Button`. Do not hand-roll `font-aeonik text-lg`-style typography.

> Custom font-size tokens (`text-h1`, `text-body`, …) are registered with tailwind-merge in
> `src/lib/utils.ts`. If you add a new token there, add it to that list too, otherwise `cn()` will
> drop it when a `text-{color}` class is also present.

#### Desktop Headings

| Style | Font | Weight | Size | Line height | Letter spacing |
| ----- | ---- | ------ | ---- | ----------- | -------------- |
| H1 | Aeonik | 600 | 80px | 120% | -2% |
| H2 | Aeonik | 600 | 48px | 120% | -2% |
| H3 | Aeonik Fono | 400 | 24px | 120% | -4% |

#### Paragraph

| Style | Font | Weight | Size | Line height | Letter spacing | Setting |
| ----- | ---- | ------ | ---- | ----------- | -------------- | ------- |
| Body-l | Aeonik Fono | 400 | 24px | 140% | -4% | Paired with H1, H2 (under) |
| Body-m | Aeonik Fono | 400 | 16px | 140% | -4% | Paired with H3 |
| Label | Aeonik Fono | 400 | 12px | 100% | 0% | Sentence case (no uppercase) |

The relevant font files are attached. You them as needed.
